messages:
sam: quick review please  PR updates the "metered_consumption" dashboard panel example and adds a short FAQ about quota enforcement across Dedicated/Private. low-risk but needs factual check on the query and the rounding note.
nina: looked — query ok but suggest using sum_over_time for 30d totals in the worked example. also add label `customer_id` in example to show per-customer split.
sam: good call. draft PromQL I put in the PR:```
sum by(customer_id) (increase(metered_consumption_total{service="api"}[30d]))
```
harry: tiny nit: docs use backticks for metric names elsewhere. please wrap `metered_consumption_total` consistently. also update the panel link to /console/usage/tiered-metering (old path 404s).
ben: pricing check: the worked example must show unit conversion explicitly: tokens -> units (1 unit = 1,000 tokens) -> price-per-unit. add a short line about prorated burst credits in monthly calc.
sam: added worked example (short):
- avg tokens/day = 120,500
- unit size = 1,000 tokens (round up) -> daily units = ceil(120500/1000) = 121
- monthly units (30d) = 3630 -> price-per-unit $0.008 -> monthly = $29.04
ben: looks good. for burst: show request using burst then billing units = ceil(max(0, tokens - burst)/1000). include cURL snippet for header:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Metering: tier=pro;burst=1500" -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```
ops-bot: created ticket DOCS-4999 for dashboard link fix (assignee: sam).
sam: thanks all. plan: merge after tiny edits and a micro-review from DevEx on snippet phrasing. harry, can you quick-check wording?
harry: will do in 30m. if green I’ll approve and docs-bot can cherry-pick to stable. :thumbsup:
